selection.rule: stateDiagram(-v2) fallback row whose frontmatter is a folded description envelope whose config block carries only the E2b admitted leaves plus the closed look and theme tables
selection.cohort_pin: reviewed literal path set (render-defined split); one atomic phase admitting both leaves
selection.twin_rule: the frame must equal the synthesized config-free twin's frame plus the recorded footer delta, line by line
selection.corpus_twins: none: every body-equivalent drawn state fixture carries logLevel/fontFamily disclosure lines that are not a prefix of the source footer, so all 28 rows use the config-free twin
selection.exclusions: layout: elk (4), namespaced config.state.* (4 — admitted by the RFC 0046 layout-tuning ledger, not this cohort), the folded description carrying a literal tab (1); the remaining rows are body-capability fallbacks

P1-look-theme.reviewer_agent: agent:acde9271b5b1810a9 rfc0038-p1-final-review (independent adversarial code review; APPROVE; re-derived the 145/28/4/4/1 source counts, the 132/61/28 -> 43 and 160-28=132 negative floors, and the corpus-twin impossibility; verified the closed tables, duplicate/indent/namespace rejection, footer order and E2b byte-identity, Work accounting, generator --check, the 5-test gate, and zero diffs on every protected file, the manifest and the E2b ledger)
P1-look-theme.note: Reviewer findings, all applied test-only before the ledger was regenerated: a quoted theme scalar positive with its dequoted footer, securityLevel added to the footer-order composition probe (pinning the append-after-existing rule), extra tab-indent / trailing-comment / mismatched-quote negatives, and a corrected over-/under-listing comment on the E2b negative. The reviewer confirmed no production mis-admission path and no assertion on the render-defined drawn/blocked split.
